text:
X509::whole
Description
Returns the specified X509 certificate, in its entirety, in PEM
format.
Syntax
X509
::
whole
<
X509
certificate
>
X509::whole <X509 certificate>
Returns the specified X509 certificate, in its entirety, in PEM
format.
Examples
when
CLIENTSSL_CLIENTCERT
{
set
client_cert
[
SSL
::
cert
0
]
log
local0.
"[X509::whole $client_cert]"
}
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
SSL
::
cert
count
]
>
0
}
{
HTTP
::
header
insert
"X-ENV-SSL_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE"
[
X509
::
whole
[
SSL
::
cert
0
]]
}
}
